chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 0432: The Eight-Nine Arcane Art vs. a Top Celestial Immortal
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning faces a Celestial Immortal Commander in an epic showdown! After a brutal stalemate, he wins Mu Northson's freedom at a devastating cost. The Soul-Prison Jade reveal changes everything.
og_title: Desolate Era 0432: A Commander humbled by the Eight-Nine Arcane Art
og_description: Ji Ning and his Primaltwin unleash their combined sword formation, forcing a powerful Celestial Immortal to concede.
twitter_title: Desolate Era Ch. 0432: The Commander's Game is Over
twitter_description: Ji Ning wins the battle, but the cost of Mu Northson's freedom shatters all hope.

lore_anchors.definition: A supreme defensive divine ability beneath the True God level, this art grants a Fiendgod Body Refiner near-invulnerability and makes them incredibly difficult to restrain or kill by an opponent of similar cultivation.
A powerful sword formation technique that can amplify the power of multiple flying swords into a single, devastating attack, typically manifested as a divine dragon.
The highest grade of Immortal-ranked treasure, representing the peak of power for such artifacts, far surpassing common or even top-grade Immortal treasures.
A legendary Xianxia material that permanently bonds with a soul placed inside it. The soul becomes one with the jade and cannot leave, suffering eternal confinement without hope for reincarnation.
A second body cultivated by a Ki Refiner at the Primal Daoist stage. It shares the same soul and consciousness and can act independently, effectively doubling the cultivator's combat output.
A grade of magic treasure surpassing Immortal-ranked artifacts. These are treasures used by True Immortals and True Gods, immensely powerful and rare.
